COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.93 of 2026
Hon’ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Shobhit Joshi and Mr. Manish 
Kumar, Advocates for the petitioner. 
Mr. Dinesh Bankoti, Brief Holder for 
the State of Uttarakhand.
2. Pursuant to an advertisement 
issued by respondent no.3 inviting 
applications for recruitment to the post 
of Lecturer (Biology) along with other 
posts, the petitioner, being duly qualified 
and eligible, submitted her application 
for the said post. Upon scrutiny of the 
application forms of all candidates by 
respondent no.3, an eligibility list was 
published on 06.11.2025, wherein the 
petitioner’s name was reflected at serial 
no.9. It is stated that the said list was 
duly forwarded to respondent no.3 by 
respondent no.2.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner 
contends that though advertisements for 
several posts were uploaded on the 
official website, no further steps have 
been taken by the respondents to 
conclude the selection process. He, 
therefore, prays that appropriate 
directions may be issued to the authority 
concerned to expedite and finalize the 
recruitment process within a time-bound 
period.
4. Issue notice to the respondent 
no.3, returnable at an early date, by 
registered post, acknowledgment due. 5. Steps to be taken, within one week.
6. List on 18.02.2026.
7. Learned State Counsel is directed to 
obtain specific instructions from the 
competent authority regarding the 
reasons for non-continuation/non￾progression of the selection process and 
to place the same before this Court on 
the next date of listing.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 
 09.01.2026
Arpan
